features.feature: CLI submission side: POST evidence envelope to authority server (off/shadow/enforce modes)
off mode: zero network, behavior byte-identical to pre-authority (KOALA_AUTHORITY_MODE unset or off)
shadow mode: best-effort POST, any authority failure outputs stderr [warning] only, local evidence unaffected
enforce mode: successful authority POST required before local write; failure means 0 local write + non-zero exit
Additive-only on authority-contracts.ts / evidence-collector.ts: no existing VCP exports touched
test:verification-context-pack-smoke must stay green (VCP digest/normalization/pack regression guard)
KOALA_AUTHORITY_URL env var config for authority server endpoint
KOALA_AUTHORITY_MODE env var parsing (off|shadow|enforce; invalid/unset -> off)
Local validation must run BEFORE authority POST (Blockers 1+2: invalid input -> 0 POSTs)
Batch all-or-nothing: any single entry local failure -> 0 POSTs for entire batch
shadow mode: ALL authority outcomes (5xx/timeout/connection-refused/throw) must not influence local evidence state
enforce mode: no local/remote fact divergence on authority failure (pre-POST ordering chosen)
verification_evidence_* commands registered in PROCESS_FACT_REGISTRY with correct process fact class
VCP creation commands (verification_context_pack_create / verification_context_pack_expand) and VCP digest parity
features.excluded_by: Understanding constraints: Out of scope: VCP files — B-2157 already delivered these; plan.md confirms additive-only, no VCP touch

features.feature: enforce batch_add: partial-accept by authority maps to whole-batch failure (0 local writes)
